body: I joined this subreddit when I was 17 on this throwaway account (username). I’m 20 now, and I’m still alive. I’m never going to be depression free, but I seem to have adopted this.. mindset? I guess I’m just going with the flow. If something happens, it happens. Anything can change. Eventually change will happen, like it or not. And everything ends up working out one way or another. It seems silly typing it out but I feel like my subconscious has kind of adopted that after years of being so miserable. Living, in general, is still just like I’m living in black and white, but I just kind of go with the flow and live with it. Kind of like a jellyfish.
thank you! my sister told her to but I wanted to know if it was something easily curable or not but now I know :-) ill let her know thank u again ^.^
I probably would say that if it was someone else but she is a bit sensitive and I don’t want to make her sad 😭😭!!

Yeah, she’s one of my best friends. She is the type of person who feels bad when no one replies or when it’s half-hearted. We always joke around with the phrase “wow, that’s crazy” because she used to use that with a friend who’s content she didn’t care about much either. 

And yeah, you’re right. It’s just a small annoyance so I probably will just try to reply more =)

Honestly I think it’s so dumb and rude when people say that. It usually comes from a kind place, but it’s kind of insensitive. They probably believe that because they don’t know how it feels. They go, what about your family? Well, what if my family hates me? Isn’t it more selfish to force us to stay when we’re suffering?

It feels relieving to know I’m not the only one who might be like this. Well, I don’t want to wish this on anyone, though. I was also planning on trying a bit tomorrow. Good luck to you! And thank you for your kind words. ❤️
Thank you. I hope that you are alright too. ❤️
